text:
A student tests an unknown compound M.
The compound:
●
produces a lilac flame using a flame test
●
produces a gas which turns limewater cloudy when dilute hydrochloric acid is added.
What is M?
A
sodium sulfate
B
sodium carbonate
C
potassium sulfate
D
potassium carbonate
subject: Chemistry
